structuralGaps.description: Asymptomatic individuals who contribute to transmission
structuralGaps.whyItMatters: Asymptomatic carriers can significantly contribute to malaria transmission
foundIn: Akowe et al. (2025) - mentions asymptomatic carriers
Multiple malaria modeling papers include asymptomatic compartments
structuralGaps.howToAdd: Add compartment: IH → AH with proportion p_asymp
structuralGaps.suggestedAction: Review literature for asymptomatic proportion values (typically 0.2-0.5)

structuralGaps.description: Compartment for individuals with severe malaria
structuralGaps.whyItMatters: Severe malaria has different mortality and treatment rates
foundIn: Age-stratified models often include severe cases
structuralGaps.howToAdd: Add compartment: IH → Severe with age-specific rates
structuralGaps.suggestedAction: Only add if modeling severe outcomes explicitly

structuralGaps.whyItMatters: Drug resistance is a major concern in malaria
structuralGaps.howToAdd: Add compartment for resistant strains if modeling resistance
structuralGaps.suggestedAction: Only add if paper focuses on drug resistance

parameterGaps.description: Parameter for proportion of infections that are asymptomatic
sources: Akowe et al. (2025) - may have region-specific values

parameterGaps.description: Parameter for insecticide-treated bed net coverage

stratificationGaps.description: No age groups defined in model
stratificationGaps.whyItMatters: Children <5 years have higher malaria risk and different severity
foundIn: Most modern malaria models include age stratification
WHO guidelines recommend age-specific modeling for malaria
stratificationGaps.suggestedAction: Review paper to see if age stratification is mentioned
stratificationGaps.note: Only required if paper mentions age groups

interventionGaps.description: Model does not include vaccination or bed net interventions
interventionGaps.whyItMatters: Interventions are key for malaria control
foundIn: Many malaria models include intervention compartments
interventionGaps.howToAdd: Add compartments for vaccinated or protected populations
interventionGaps.note: Only required if paper is about interventions
